---
title: "A format extension reads its own language file"
format: langfile-html
toc: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    langfile-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the extension</h2>']
        - []
---

## Section

The `langfile` extension sets `language: _language.yml` for its HTML format.
Before the fix, Quarto looked for this file in `_extensions/_extensions/langfile/` and the render stopped.
The table of contents must show the title from the language file of the extension.
